key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued tsunami alert level 3 advising immediate evacuation for coastal areas of Eastern Samar and Leyte.
Evacuations occurred widely; surveyed barangays reported an average 80% of residents evacuated.
Warning dissemination delays and communication/power outages occurred; in parts of Eastern Samar messages arrived after the expected wave arrival.
No significant tsunami wave occurred and no damages were observed; the alert was canceled early on 1 September 2012.
evidence_snippets: On 31 August 2012 a strong earthquake occurred in the Philippine Trench east of the southern tip of Eastern Samar.
PHIVOLCS issued alert level 3 (immediate evacuation) including coastal areas of Eastern Samar and Leyte.
No significant wave appeared and no damages were observed; alert canceled at 12:10 am, 1 September 2012.
missing_information: Exact shaking intensity by named location not provided.
No damage or casualty figures; impacts mainly evacuations and communication issues.
